case.summary: Alert HHG-017 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.57 on online transaction 3450629 ($100.09), elevated due to the use of an IP proxy. In contrast, the calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.014 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006. The purchase perfectly aligns with the cardholder's normal behavior, directly continuing an evening session that included two other identical-amount purchases on known device D006670. Graph analysis shows no connection to fraud rings, an uncompromised community with zero fraud lift, and an exclusively clean prior case history. The transaction is verified as legitimate cardholder activity and closed as a false positive.
